commands.command: targeted compatible comment HTTP contract with -race

verifiedBehavior: Global and organization-prefixed comment routes accept event read/write scopes.
POST and PUT require the CommentSchema data.text body and reject unknown fields.
Responses expose numeric IDs, note type, text, UTC creation and user id/email.
Cursor pagination emits next Link metadata.
Authors/owners/admins use native comment activity and deletion semantics.
